answer: Invitation quotas with kinship decay cap sybil seeding. Each established identity may invite one newcomer per season, and the referral earns only if the kinship ledger clears the pair: shared funding, custody, or a transfer thread gets the edge inked umber and voided. Rewards decay with invitee age and are clawed back when a recruit is proven a clone. An operator cannot seed a thousand fakes from its own quota; it must persuade a thousand honest strangers to burn a scarce slot each, while honest newcomers wait on the ledge and dead referrals drift off like dune dust.
